+### Aset
+

+
+Consistency means a gate named once reads the same wherever it appears, and the deck's two gate marks, G2 and G3, said nothing where a cold reader first meets them. They open the ask on the summary — G2 ask, G3 A/B — a whole slide before the roadmap spells them out. Prior rounds settled the one-ninth gate, NBA, IA, CTS and WTP; this round settles the gate names where they first appear: G2 approves the measurement design, G3 runs the instrumented A/B. Founder, your two checkpoints name themselves early. Investors, the evidence ladder is legible from the summary onward. Future customers, the deck now speaks its gates plainly to you.
